start.title: Which shiny are you after?
start.subtitle: Pick your target. Then choose the game and method, and start counting.

counter.phaseCount: {n, plural, one {# in this phase} other {# in this phase}}

stats.chanceHint: The chance of seeing at least one shiny in this many encounters.
stats.multipleHint: Encounters divided by the odds: past 1× you've gone longer than the odds.
stats.perHourHint: Encounters per hour while the timer ran.
stats.timerHint: The timer starts with your first count and stops by itself after 10 minutes without one.

setup.chainHintDexNav: Every 5th Pokémon in a chain gets extra checks, the 50th and 100th more still. The odds are for the next one.
setup.chainHintWrap: The bonus stops growing at {n}. The game's counter starts over after {max}.

levelHint.searchLevel: The species' Search Level, shown in the DexNav (up to 999).
levelHint.distance: The bonus stops growing at 5,000 light-years. Ringed wormholes appear from 1,000, three rings from 2,500.

setup.source: Odds from the games' code and datamines, checked against Bulbapedia and Serebii.

methodHints.wild: Wild Pokémon and soft resets at the game's base rate.
methodHints.eggs: Eggs from parents from games in the same language.
methodHints.breeding: An egg that inherits a shiny parent's DVs (from a Ditto, or from the parent of the other gender).
methodHints.masuda: Eggs from parents from games in two different languages.
methodHints.pokeRadar: The chance for each shaking patch that continues your chain.
methodHints.friendSafari: Every Pokémon in the Friend Safari gets extra checks.
methodHints.chainFishing: Each Pokémon hooked in a row adds to the odds, up to 20.
methodHints.horde: Five Pokémon at once, each with its own chance: count by 5.
methodHints.dexNav: Hidden Pokémon found with the DexNav, by Search Level and chain.
methodHints.sos: Each ally called in a row adds to the odds.
methodHints.wormhole: The Pokémon at the end of an Ultra Warp Ride: count one per trip.
methodHints.catchCombo: Catching the same Pokémon in a row adds to the odds.
methodHints.brilliant: Count only Pokémon with a glowing aura. The more of the species you've battled, the better.
methodHints.dynamax: A flat chance for each Pokémon you choose to keep.
methodHints.underground: Pokémon in the Hideaways, with or without the Diglett bonus.
methodHints.massiveOutbreak: Outbreaks inside a massive mass outbreak.
methodHints.hyperspace: Wild Pokémon in Hyperspace, with a donut's Sparkling Power.

games.lgpe: Let's Go, Pikachu! & Let's Go, Eevee!
